visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a white bento box filled with white rice topped with vibrant red slices of red yeast pork (Char Siu). The camera then pans to another bento box featuring a large, glazed golden-brown grilled chicken leg, broccoli, and scrambled eggs. A person uses wooden chopsticks to lift the chicken leg, revealing its juicy interior. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a restaurant. A small group of customers, including an older man in a blue shirt and a woman in a brown top, queue in front of a counter. A digital menu board above the service window displays various bento options with prices. A male staff member wearing a black t-shirt and a red surgical mask stands behind the counter. (3) A close-up shows a printed receipt held against a blurred background of the store. The camera then scans across a glass-fronted food display case containing at least ten different colorful side dishes, such as mapo tofu, stir-fried cabbage, and bamboo shoots. Staff members in blue gloves and black aprons use metal spoons to scoop generous portions into paper bento boxes. (4) In a close-up, a metal spoon adds a spoonful of spicy diced pickled vegetables (Laba pickles) onto a bed of rice next to red pork slices. This is followed by a shot of a large stainless steel pot containing a clear clam soup with ginger strips. Another close-up shows a hand pulling a lever on a metal drink dispenser, filling a small clear plastic bag with a light amber-colored beverage. (5) Several quick cuts show the main meat items in detail: the glistening skin of the roasted chicken leg and the tender texture of the pink red yeast pork. A person's hand holds a slice of the pork to the camera. (6) A 'double combo' bento box is showcased, containing a chicken leg and a fried pork chop. Behind the counter, two female staff members in black uniforms and blue gloves efficiently pack bento boxes at a stainless steel table, wrapping them with rubber bands. One staff member hands a white plastic bag to a customer at the counter. (7) The final shot is an exterior view of the restaurant building on an urban street. Large vertical signs with the brand names '鼎香' (Ding Xiang) and '大利' are prominent against a clear blue sky with some power lines visible.
